text:
Oliver K: Heads-up: flying to Berlin next week for a sprint. Staying near Kreuzberg  any recs for good currywurst, doner, and coffee? also need at least one solid vegan spot.
Sofie: Must-hit: Curry 36 for a classic currywurst experience (cash friendly). Expect a line but quick.
Jan: For vegan doner try 'Vöner' near Revaler Str. super tasty and pocket-friendly.
Amira: If you want bakery vibes, go to 'Bäckerei Siebert' in the morning  great pretzels and they do a seeded rye that's GF-ish? ask them.
Oliver K: GF-ish? i'll ask. Any sit-down dinner ideas for team of 5 that can handle veg/vegan + meat folks?
Sofie: 'Transit' in Kreuzberg does Mediterranean small plates, very flexible with swaps. Book for 5 on Fri.
Jan: If you're crossing to Mitte, 'Katz Orange' is a bit pricier but they have good options and a nice private table space.
Amira: Coffee: The Barn (Rosenthaler) for pour-overs, or 'Bonanza' near Kreuzberg for espresso. Both open early.
Oliver K: Late-night snack after the sprint? We might want something open past 11pm.
Jan: Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap is legendary but closes earlier sometimes. For late kebab, try 'Kebab House' on Oranienstr.
Sofie: Also, note that many places close early on Sundays. plan accordingly.
SnackBot: Travel note saved: "BER Kreuzberg eats: Curry 36 (currywurst), Vöner (vegan doner), Transit (group-friendly small plates), Katz Orange (Mitte sit-down), The Barn / Bonanza (coffee), Kebab House (late-night)." Run `travel notes add berlin` to append to your trip pack.
Oliver K: Amazing, thanks! I'll try Curry 36 first night and book Transit for Fri. anyone want to join the group dinner? react with :raised_hand: or say 'I'll pass'.
Sofie: :raised_hand:
Jan: I'll pass (time zone headache)
Amira: :raised_hand: count me in.
Oliver K: Great. i'll book for 5 Fri 7:30. cheers! :beers:
